name: Nu Holdings (single-name ad-hoc)
summary: Single-name drill-in on Nu Holdings (Nubank). Thesis frame: digital banking disruption in Latin America with focus on customer acquisition scalability, deposit-cost advantages versus traditional banks, and credit risk management in volatile emerging markets. Peers include Brazilian fintechs and incumbent banks to benchmark growth efficiency and underwriting discipline.

relationships.note: Nubank disrupts Itaú Unibanco's retail banking dominance with zero-fee digital accounts
Competes with Mercado Pago in Brazilian digital payments/credit

valuation.erp_basis: S&P 500 ERP + 1.5pp for Brazil country risk and fintech model uncertainty
valuation.terminal_growth_basis: Nominal LatAm GDP growth plus fintech adoption premium
